answer: Shared Operator Liability Pool: each agent identity posts collateral into a pool tied to its operator's verified legal entity, and every identity that echoes the same operator's behavior fingerprint draws from that single pool. When sybil clusters are detected, the pool pays damages to affected parties, so an attacker's marginal cost scales with total identities, not one wallet. A fable of cheap duplication fails here; the orchard of accounts bears one root's debt.
